title: Production build environment has DEV_BYPASS and BYPASS_PERMISSIONS unset or false across all services
description: Quick build-verification check before any deployment: confirm the environment configuration for vibrantix-backend (DEV_BYPASS) and vendor-service (BYPASS_PERMISSIONS) does not carry a true value into the production environment file/secrets.
preconditions: Access to the production deployment's environment configuration
steps: Inspect the production environment variables for vibrantix-backend: DEV_BYPASS, SKIP_JWKS_VERIFY
Inspect the production environment variables for vendor-service: BYPASS_PERMISSIONS
Confirm NODE_ENV=production is explicitly set (not left to default to the Docker image's baked-in 'development')
expectedResult: DEV_BYPASS, SKIP_JWKS_VERIFY, and BYPASS_PERMISSIONS are all absent or 'false' in production; NODE_ENV is explicitly 'production'.

title: New organization dashboard loads without console errors and shows an empty (not fabricated) compliance score
preconditions: A newly created org with zero configured frameworks
steps: Log in as the new org's admin and open the dashboard
Check browser devtools console for errors
Read the compliance score widget value
expectedResult: No console errors; compliance score widget shows 'Not configured' rather than any numeric percentage.

title: A single spot-check request for another org's resource ID returns 403/404, not the resource
description: Fast pre-release sanity check standing in for the fuller IDOR regression suite (TISO-SEC-004, TISO-SEC-009) — one representative resource type per deploy.
preconditions: Two test orgs each with one risk record
steps: As an Org A test user, call GET /api/risks/:id using Org B's risk ID
expectedResult: 403 or 404 returned; no risk title/description/score from Org B present in the response body.

title: Project selector only lists projects belonging to the currently active organization
preconditions: Test user is a member of Org A (2 projects) and Org B (1 project)
steps: With Org A as the active organization, open the project selector dropdown
expectedResult: Exactly the 2 projects belonging to Org A are listed — Org B's project never appears.

title: Socket.IO connection for a test user joins only their own org-scoped room, visible in server connection logs
preconditions: Backend logging enabled at info level for socket connections
steps: Connect a test client authenticated as an Org A user
Inspect the backend log line for the socket connection (e.g. '[SOCKET] ... joined user:... + org:...')
expectedResult: Log line shows the socket joined `org:{orgA-id}:user:{userId}` — never another org's ID.
